title: Corkscrew Estates Estero FL: What Can You Build on a Nearly One-Acre Lot? 2026
excerpt: Corkscrew Estates is a gated enclave of 59 Pulte estate homes on nearly one-acre lots in unincorporated Lee County, with an Estero address. What you can add to a lot, from a pool house to a generator, depends on the HOA's declaration, Lee County's zoning code, and Florida's HOA statute, which limits what the association can deny.
